analyst.summary: Sundaram Finance closed FY26 with AUM +16.4% to Rs.59,908cr, best-in-class asset quality (net Stage-3 improved to 0.69%) and cost ratios (28.71% C/I), but Q4FY26 standalone profit growth stalled (~flat YoY) as employee and funding costs ran ahead of revenue growth for the quarter even as the full year posted +19% PAT growth. Valuation is premium (3.31x P/B, 23.4x P/E) but roughly justified by the growth being delivered; no regulatory or governance overhang identified. Q1FY27 results not yet released as of 20-Jul-2026.
